name: Ramadan
overview: Scripture reveals that true fasting and repentance must be sincere and not for show, as Jesus warns against the hypocritical display of fasting (Matthew 6:16). Isaiah calls God's people to recognize their sins and transgressions openly (Isaiah 58:1), yet acknowledges that all human righteousness is as filthy rags apart from God's grace (Isaiah 64:6). The heart of God's message is found in His love demonstrated through Christ, who perfectly fulfilled the Father's will (John 3:16; John 5:30), offering eternal life to all who believe. Thus, fasting without faith in Christ’s redemptive work is insufficient for true spiritual renewal.
